node_definition.done_when: A test delivers a run with a clean stored review in a temporary repository, runs one reflex pass, and reads its head an ancestor of the primary branch, the merged-head gate log recorded and the section declared done. A second test gives a head that conflicts with the primary branch and reads the run left delivered with an obligation naming the conflict. A third gives a gate that fails at the merged head and reads the run left delivered with the failure ids named. A fourth gives a clean run whose plan says its coordinator lands it by hand, and reads it left delivered, unmerged, with no landing attempted. A fifth promotes a run whose merge then conflicts, and reads the outcome as not merged, naming the pending landing, while every view that reports landing state shows the run as not landed. A negative control that stops after promotion leaves the first test's head off the primary branch. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
